definitions.gloss: to be in full bloom, to bloom magnificently
definitions.explanation: To bloom in full glory, with flowers at the peak of their beauty. Conveys a sense of splendor and abundance in blooming.

examples.japanese: {桜|さくら}が{咲|さ}き{誇|ほこ}っている。
examples.english: The cherry blossoms are in full bloom.

examples.japanese: {庭|にわ}のバラが{美|うつく}しく{咲|さ}き{誇|ほこ}っていた。
examples.english: The roses in the garden were blooming magnificently.

examples.japanese: {春|はる}になると、{公園|こうえん}の{花壇|かだん}に{色|いろ}とりどりの{花|はな}が{咲|さ}き{誇|ほこ}る。
examples.english: When spring comes, colorful flowers bloom in full glory in the park's flower beds.

notes:
Godan verb (る row: {咲|さ}き{誇|ほこ}る → {咲|さ}き{誇|ほこ}らない → {咲|さ}き{誇|ほこ}って). A compound of {咲|さ}く (to bloom) + {誇|ほこ}る (to boast/be proud), suggesting flowers blooming so splendidly they seem to boast. Often used in literary and poetic descriptions of nature.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {桜|さくら}が{咲|さ}き{誇|ほこ}る — cherry blossoms in full bloom
- {花|はな}が{咲|さ}き{誇|ほこ}る — flowers in full bloom
- {一面|いちめん}に{咲|さ}き{誇|ほこ}る — to bloom across an entire area
